test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

We are preparing a detailed report on environmental hazards.

options.text: A detailed report on environmental hazards is being prepared by us.
We have prepared a detailed report on environmental hazards.
The report was prepared on environmental hazards by us.
A detailed report on environmental hazards has been prepared by us.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "We are preparing a detailed report on environmental hazards."
 
• This sentence is in the **Present Continuous** tense. The rule for conversion is: *Subject + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Object.*
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "A detailed report on environmental hazards" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "are preparing" to "is being prepared."
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "us."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A detailed report on environmental hazards is being prepared by us."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"We have prepared a detailed report on environmental hazards." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to Present Perfect and remains in the active voice.
 
• **Option 3: **"The report was prepared on environmental hazards by us." – Incorrect because it uses the Past Simple tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"A detailed report on environmental hazards has been prepared by us." – Incorrect because it uses the Present Perfect Passive tense.
